breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identifies only the Dirichlet boundary condition ('Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 on all boundaries') and omits the incorrect periodic one, thus resolving the inconsistency.
